subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which official OpenClaw-controlled account or organization should own the production GitHub OAuth app, and who is authorized to perform the credential rotation?
rationale: Repository code only consumes the credentials; ownership transfer, secret custody, and production rotation require an explicit authorized human decision.

options.title: Transfer to official organization
options.body: Transfer or recreate the OAuth app under an official OpenClaw organization, rotate production credentials, and capture fresh web and CLI proof.

options.title: Document temporary personal custody
options.body: Retain the current owner temporarily only with an explicit exception, named migration owner, and dated follow-up plan.

recommendation.title: Transfer to official organization
recommendation.body: Transfer or recreate the OAuth app under an official OpenClaw organization, rotate production credentials, and capture fresh web and CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They were assigned the prior exact report and are the clearest available coordinator for the required production-auth decision.
